head.name: Dr. Eng. Ir. Totok Mujiono, M.IKom.
head.bio:
Dr. Eng. Ir. Totok Mujiono, M.IKom. is a lecturer in the Electronics Engineering group of the Departemen Teknik Elektro, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, and leads the Laboratorium Mikroelektronika dan Sistem Tertanam. He completed his undergraduate studies in electrical engineering (electronics) at ITS, a master's degree in computer science at Universitas Indonesia, and a doctorate in physical electronics at the Tokyo Institute of Technology.

His research centres on biosensor engineering with quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) and optical transducers for gas and liquid detection — including graphene-coated QCM sensors for volatile organic compounds, QCM sensor arrays for odour detection, and fluorescence-based optical biosensors. He also develops sensor electronics and low-power, portable microprocessor- and FPGA-based sensor systems.
